description: Phone number parser — Offline phone number check: normalizes any format to E.164, detects the country calling code (70+ countries), applies NANP rules for +1 numbers (area/exchange code validity, toll-free, premium 900, 555-01XX fiction range, placeholders), guesses mobile vs other for major countries and splits extensions. Params: number (required), country (ISO2 default for numbers without +, default US). Does not check if the line is live. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_phone
